surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 11 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Aadiyaat (The Chargers) is the 100th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 11 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والعاديات ضبحا
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the charging steeds that pant

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and strike sparks with their hooves

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Arriving thereby in the center collectively
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and plunging into the midst of the enemy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: man is ungrateful to his Lord––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, he is to that a witness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and He is witness to this––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ افلا يعلم اذا بعثر ما في القبور
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that within the breasts is obtained
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: their Lord will be fully aware of them all
